dashboard.label: Distributed Lab Health
dashboard.description: UF resource measurements and data delivery to Splunk.

search.query: | makeresults | eval host="example-forwarder", expected=1 | append [search index=example_ops sourcetype=example:metrics earliest=1 latest=+1d _index_earliest=-30m | eval host=lower(host) | sort 0 - _indextime - _time | dedup host | eval indexed_at=_indextime, ingest_seconds=_indextime-_time | fields host indexed_at ingest_seconds] | stats max(expected) AS expected max(indexed_at) AS indexed_at max(ingest_seconds) AS ingest_seconds BY host | eval age_seconds=round(now()-indexed_at), status=case(isnull(expected),"Unexpected host",isnull(indexed_at),"No sample in window",age_seconds>720,"Silent",ingest_seconds< -60,"Clock ahead",ingest_seconds>600,"Arriving late or clock behind",true(),"Reporting") | eval last_indexed=strftime(indexed_at,"%F %T %z") | table host status last_indexed age_seconds ingest_seconds
index=example_ops sourcetype=example:metrics host=example-forwarder | timechart span=5m avg(cpu_usage) AS CPU avg(ram_usage) AS RAM
index=example_ops sourcetype=example:metrics host=example-forwarder metrics_version=2 | eval available_gib=disk_available_kib/1048576 | timechart span=5m min(available_gib) AS Available

panel.title: Latest UF filesystem and system measurements

search.query: index=example_ops sourcetype=example:metrics host=example-forwarder metrics_version=2 | sort 0 - _time | head 1 | eval available_gib=round(disk_available_kib/1048576,2), capacity=if(disk_available_kib<6291456,"Below 6 GiB","OK") | table _time host available_gib disk_used_pct capacity load_1m uptime_seconds swap_used_kib

index=example_ops sourcetype=example:metrics host=example-forwarder earliest=1 latest=+1d _index_earliest=-60m | eval ingest_seconds=_indextime-_time, _time=_indextime | bin _time span=5m | stats perc95(ingest_seconds) AS P95 BY _time
